R-S0.use_when: The user limits the note to supplied material.

R-S1.use_when: The user permits outside verification while keeping the supplied source primary.

R-S2.use_when: The user permits added explanations or examples beyond the source.

R-I.use_when: No supplied source controls the content.

R-C.use_when: The task compares claims or methods across sources.

R-L.use_when: The learner requests an extensive literature review.

R-R.use_when: The task is to recommend further-learning resources.
